text:
Some people put aside part of every salary, while others enjoy their money as they earn it, and opinions differ on whether it is better to save or to spend freely. This essay will consider both views before explaining my own opinion.

On the one hand, supporters of saving argue that it brings security. Savers can meet emergencies and long-term goals. A family with several months of income in the bank, for example, can survive the loss of a job or an unexpected hospital bill without borrowing, and they can pay a deposit on a home or finance their children's education. Saving encourages discipline and reduces stress, because people feel more in control of their future. In old age, savings supplement a pension. Money that is saved and invested also provides funds for businesses to grow, so that it benefits the wider economy.

On the other hand, supporters of spending argue that life should be enjoyed now and that spending supports the economy. Those who never spend miss experiences, and nobody can be sure that they will live to enjoy their savings. A young couple who use their money to travel together, for example, create memories that last for life. Spending also supports shops, restaurants and jobs, and when consumers cut back too much, the economy slows. However, heavy spenders risk debt, and a sudden loss of income can lead to serious difficulty. A budget with both is most sensible. Many financial advisers suggest using a fixed share of income for needs, for wants and for saving, which allows people to enjoy the present while preparing for the future.

In conclusion, both views have merit. Overall, I believe that a balance between saving and spending is wisest, with enough saving to be secure and enough spending to enjoy life.

analysis.type_vi: Discuss both views: tiết kiệm hay chi tiêu thoải mái

plan.think: Mở bài nêu người để dành lương, người hưởng ngay; hai phe.

An toàn: ứng phó khẩn cấp, mục tiêu dài hạn; ví dụ gia đình có thu nhập vài tháng trong ngân hàng sống sót khi mất việc, hoá đơn bệnh viện không vay, trả tiền đặt cọc nhà, học phí con; kỷ luật, giảm căng thẳng; tuổi già bổ sung lương hưu; tiền đầu tư cho doanh nghiệp.

Hưởng hiện tại, hỗ trợ kinh tế: không chi bỏ lỡ trải nghiệm, không chắc sống để hưởng; ví dụ cặp trẻ du lịch tạo ký ức cả đời; chi tiêu nuôi cửa hàng, nhà hàng, việc làm; cắt quá nhiều kinh tế chậm; nhưng chi nhiều nợ, mất thu nhập đột ngột khó khăn; ngân sách cả hai: tỷ lệ cố định cho nhu cầu, mong muốn, tiết kiệm.
